body:
## Wearer stats (EntadWearerStats.cs)
- Entad trait offsets on pawn stats (IsWearerStat categories) reach the holder through a postfix on `StatWorker.StatOffsetFromGear`. `StatPart_Entad` skips those offsets when it evaluates apparel or equipment, so they aren't counted twice. Buildings still get theirs, e.g. MeditationFocusStrength on furniture.
- "Relevant gear": `GearAffectsStat` only sees a ThingDef, so a [ThreadStatic] `explainingPawn` is set around `GetExplanationUnfinalized` (prefix + finalizer) and during each MoveNext of `GetInfoCardHyperlinks` (enumerator wrapper). An item is listed when the pawn holds one of that def with a non-zero revealed entad offset (1e-4 tolerance). Hidden-only items aren't listed, but their effect still applies.
- Hiding unrevealed traits in displays:
  - `displayExcludesHidden` is set during `InfoTextLineFromGear` (the pawn's gear line).
  - `gearCardThing` is set during `ThingDef.SpecialDisplayStats` for an entad item (its own equipped-offset rows).
  - Both are honoured only by the StatOffsetFromGear postfix and by StatPart_Entad on WEARER stats. That path is never cached. Other stats read meanwhile go through `GetValue`, which writes the stat cache, so they must keep the hidden effects.
- `CompEntad.WearerOffset(stat, out hiddenPart)` caches the total and the unrevealed sum per stat. It returns early when the item has no traits, which is the case for nearly all gear.

## Startup
- `EntadStatPartInjector` adds `StatPart_Entad` to every stat a trait references, plus MarketValue, and clears the `immutable` flag on those stats. SetImmutability ran before static constructors, and an immutable stat would cache values forever.
- Harmony patches are then applied one class at a time, each in its own try/catch, so a failing runtime-target patch disables only its own feature.
- `CompEntad.TraitsChanged` and `RemoveTrait` clear the item's and the holder's stat caches. RemoveTrait clears before removing the trait from the list.

## Open items
- Hiding unrevealed traits on item cards for non-wearer stats (damage, etc.) would need a cache bypass in StatWorker.GetValue. Not done.
- `gearFlags` is a one-time snapshot taken on first use.
- Def hot-reload in dev mode doesn't re-run the injector.

## Dev tools
- "Add specific Entad trait" lists applicable traits first, then the rest, alphabetically within each group.
